title: One-Hot Encoding
signature: def one_hot(labels: np.ndarray, num_classes: int) -> np.ndarray
hints: Start from an (n, num_classes) array of zeros.
Row i needs a 1 in column labels[i]. Index with two arrays at once: out[rows, labels] = 1.
Use num_classes for the width, not labels.max() + 1. The largest class may not appear in this batch.
